text_block_list.name: Tomo
text_block_list.text:
There it is again!
That's the same enemy as before, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
また現れた！
さっきと同じ敵、
みたいだね……！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what's going on?!
Didn't we defeat it back there?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お、
おかしいッス！
倒したはずッスよ！？

text_block_list.name: Christina
text_block_list.text:
No... This is a different specimen.
Its aura is on a different level.
Perhaps this one will put up more of a fight!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや、
別の個体だな。
明らかに纏う空気が違う。
中々の獲物みたいじゃないか！

text_block_list.name: Jun
text_block_list.text:
I see... It does indeed seem more fearsome.
We must stay vigilant.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なるほど、
クリスちゃんの言う通りみたいだ。
油断は禁物だな。
